original_metadata.title: The two-sided discrete Schrodinger operator with the authored complex interface has a bounded compact Green inverse for real uniformly positive confining potentials and phase from zero inclusive to pi over two exclusive
original_metadata.author: Ebru Ergun
original_metadata.source_title: On the Spectrum of a Discrete Non-Hermitian Quantum System
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: A positive potential alone does not supply a Green kernel compatible with the complex impulse matching at the missing lattice sites. The author constructs two independent half-line square-summable solutions through nested fractional-linear disks and weighted energy identities, then proves that the resulting infinite Green series maps the whole sequence Hilbert space into the operator domain. A uniform inverse bound and a separate potential-weighted tail estimate yield compactness without assuming Hermitian spectral theory.

proof_review.note: Read exact deleted-site Hilbert space, operator/domain and impulse extensions4-5; complete recurrence/impulse existence and Wronskian/variation setup8-10; energy identities and full nested-circle construction of two independent half-line square-summable solutions11-17; full complex weighted interface identity17-18; Green kernel formula and entire injectivity, truncation/Cauchy-limit, surjectivity/domain and inverse estimate Theorem9 on18-21; and full weighted-tail compactness Theorem10 proof21-23. Select the consolidated compact Green inverse result with the exact operator L=-Delta^2+q and phase0<=delta<pi/2, q_n real with q_n>=c>0 and q_n->infinity at both ends. Standard scalar recurrence existence and the explicit l2 compactness criterion are cited foundations; all new interface/wave/Green/infinite-sum arguments are written. Do not count Wronskian or energy helpers, the classical Hermitian case separately, spectral reality/PT claims, or a different potential/phase family. The illustrative boundary expansions on5 print positive second-difference parentheses after the negative-difference definition; the exact defining formula and all selected Green/energy recurrences consistently retain the negative second difference. Preserve those source displays with the warning, rather than correcting them.

original_metadata.statement_scope: One consolidated Theorem9 plus Theorem10 compact Green inverse on l2(Z0), Z0=Z minus{0,1}. Let 0<=delta<pi/2, real q_n>=c>0 onZ0 and q_n->infinity as abs(n)->infinity. Define D={y in l2(Z0):q_n y_n in l2(Z0)}, L y_n=-Delta^2 y_(n-1)+q_n y_n, extending y1=y_minus1 and y0=(1-exp(2i delta))y_minus1+exp(2i delta)y2. Then L has the original whole-space Green inverse(6.6), norm at most1/(c cos delta), and that inverse is compact. No assertion of real eigenvalues, diagonalizability or arbitrary complex potentials.
